newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt bank raises 1996 profits 9.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Egypt bank raises 1996 profits 9.4 pct.

text.p: Egyptian American Bank said in a statement published on Saturday it increased net profits for calendar 1996 to 90.55 million pounds ($26.68 million) from 82.73 million in the previous year.
The bank said customer deposits rose to 3.15 billion in 1996 from 2.90 billion while net investments increased to 1.07 billion from 764 million in 1995.

The bank also said it would finally approve the results in its annual general meeting to be held on June 16. The board will also decide on a suggestion to increase the legal reserves by another 60 million pounds so that they equal the bank's 120 million issued capital.
Privately owned Egyptian American Bank is a joint venture between American Express Bank and the state's Bank of Alexandria and has shares listed on the Cairo stock exchange.
Amex Holdings owns 40.8 percent, Bank of Alexandria 42.5 percent while the bank's workers and the public hold the remaining 16.7 percent.
